findings.description: Direct inspection of all five current views and six pose renders shows strong angular faceting and irregular clumped folds across the skirt, with uneven pointed split-front edges. The overall skirt silhouette is not visually continuous.

Direct inspection of crouch and sit renders shows large rounded shorts-like thigh shells bulging ahead of the overskirt; the apron panels separate into sharp narrow flaps and leave visible gaps over the anterior thighs. The seated and crouched coverage and shell volume remain unacceptable.
The rear waist adjustment tab remains a small low-contrast shape in the full-body back render and cannot be read as a distinct functional detail; no close-up evidence shows improved legibility.

The direct raster inspection of the current source-bound chart shows readable, separated packed islands for the three objects carrying the explicit AuthoredPatternPanels layer. The showcase correctly omits 18 objects whose active UVMap provenance is unverified and reports four objects with no active UV layer as UV not created. These missing/unverified garment UVs block complete UV acceptance; no replacement UV coordinates were generated.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V41 packs source-authored pattern panel bounds at one shared unrotated scale with fixed gutters. Directly reviewed current five views, six pose renders, and a raster of the current UV SVG. The three visibly authored pattern UV objects form separate packed islands; 18 active UVMap layers are provenance-unverified and omitted; four objects have no UV layer. Skirt form/faceting, sit/crouch thigh coverage and rear tab readability remain rejected. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package and release remain unverified.
sourceEvidence.uvMappingStatus: PARTIAL_SOURCE_AUTHORED: 3/25 objects; 18 active layers provenance unverified and omitted; 4 objects UV not created. Direct visual chart: islands separated and legible; complete UV coverage not accepted.

nextAction: Revise skirt drape and split hem, improve front thigh coverage and reduce rounded shell volume in sit/crouch poses, enlarge and contrast the rear waist tab, then regenerate source-bound previews and inspect. Resolve provenance for active UVMap layers only from actual product coordinates and add UVs only when authored; currently report the 18 unverified and four not-created objects without substituting UVs.
